content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (EXCLUSIVITY, high).**

- **Responsive clause:** first § 2.2 (p0013) — "Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term." This is the only exclusivity obligation binding us; the other "exclusive" hits (§ 13.1 non-exclusive licence, § 19.4 / § 21.4 / § 30.2 exclusive-remedy language, § 28.2 exclusive forum) are out of scope for this rule.
- **Why it fails fallback:** full-term exclusive dealing with no 12-month cap and no automatic termination on service-level or delivery-date failure — walk-away territory — and it contradicts § 2.1 (no purchase commitment) and § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no exclusivity commitment).
- **Cure (preferred, validated ok:true):** one surgical replace making Vendor a non-exclusive provider and confirming Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation, preserving the rest of the clause and resolving the internal conflict. Fallback offered in the comment.
